card.name: Mid-sentence words in clinical trial text
card.fires_on: Ordinary words, number pieces and partial names in the middle of clinical-trial or label sentences, such as 'patients' after a percentage or 'be' in 'should be given'. It is not tied to one word.

modes.label: Words after trial percentages
modes.description: A common word like 'patients' or 'in' right after a percentage or drug name in adverse-event reporting.

modes.label: Inside names and numbers
modes.description: A piece within a study name, drug name or number that is not yet complete.

modes.label: Linking words in instructions
modes.description: Small words inside set phrases about duration or dose adjustment.
modes.example: voriconazole was administered for<< at>> least 14 days after the last

card.plain: It fires on filler words and word pieces in the middle of dense trial-result sentences, with no single meaning.
